evidence: The rejected command supplies -J twice; the second jump-host option is extraneous and changes the intended connection specification.
The rejected command changes both the named host and requested remote journalctl unit, and adds unrelated SSH options.
The request names private.pem; the rejected command silently substitutes a different key path.
The rejected glob treats TODO text as a path filter, omits the requested search pattern and repository path, and does not exclude .git.
Without --diff-filter=AM, the rejected command includes deleted and other changed paths rather than only added or modified staged files.
The rejected -printf fields output link count, symlink target, and relative path instead of the requested inode, link count, and full path.
The rejected exit-on-fix spelling is not the requested --exit-non-zero-on-fix behavior for GitHub-annotation linting.
The rejected selector filters non-success status rather than Warning events, and its sort expression is not the requested .lastTimestamp JSON path.
The rejected command omits systemctl cat, so it does not print the service unit and drop-ins.
The rejected invocation omits verbose output and selects slow-marked tests instead of excluding them with the requested marker expression.
The rejected verify command omits -purpose sslserver, so it does not apply the requested server-authentication purpose.
-perm /022 means any group-or-other writable bit, while the rejected exact 022 mode requires a different permission pattern.
The rejected command omits the explicitly requested src and tests targets, widening formatting checks beyond the stated scope.
The rejected command replaces the containers breakdown with unsupported shorthand flags and does not express the requested pods resource view.
The rejected invocation adds -s and omits the explicitly requested tests/unit target.
The rejected command omits the explicitly requested tests/integration target.
Without --now, the rejected command leaves debug.service running instead of stopping it immediately.
'1 day ago' is a rolling 24-hour window, not the requested calendar boundary 'today'.
The rejected rule codes and exclusion do not request F401/F821 while excluding generated files under src.
The rejected remote-forward specification reverses the requested port mapping and host placement.
The rejected command omits the 100-line limit and uses an invalid output value instead of short-precise timestamps.
Without --all, the rejected command omits indirect dependencies requested for network.target.
The rejected command changes the named deploy key and replaces disabled password authentication with unrelated host-key checking.
The rejected --case-sensitive setting reverses the explicitly requested case-insensitive search.
The rejected regex only permits whitespace between begin and end, whereas the requested dotall expression permits arbitrary intervening text across lines.
The rejected command omits --no-block and therefore does not satisfy the requested non-blocking completion behavior.
The rejected command omits case-insensitive matching and changes both the requested whole-word PCRE2 pattern and search scope.
The rejected command does not exclude target and adds --no-ignore plus a Rust-source-only glob that changes the requested file set.
